statements: The system is currently under active development, and the LLM runtime model may vary dynamically (e.g., OpenRouter API integrations, llama3.1:8b, or local fallbacks).
The AISystem framework utilizes a modular skill architecture executing via PHP 8.0+.
Memory management is split between a lightweight root index (memory.json) and isolated topic logs in memory/topics/.
All state memory operations rely on dynamic JSON storage with zero database or SQL dependencies.
Interactive runtime applications operate on cfcbazar.42web.io with reusable helpers included via /includes/reusable.php.
Standalone microservices and processing APIs execute on cfcbazar.atwebpages.com.
Public indexing and canonical SEO landing pages are served from cc.free.bg.
Fact ingestion automatically cleans list markers and appends ISO-8601 timestamps to memory entries.
